api/src/services/openai_transport_detect.name: Compatible service check
api/src/services/openai_transport_detect.description: Tests which way a compatible AI service accepts requests, once per saved connection, so calls choose the right one first time.

api/src/services/opencode_go_detection.p.name: OpenCode Go check
api/src/services/opencode_go_detection.p.description: Tests which request style the OpenCode Go service accepts for a model, once per saved connection.

api/src/services/opencode_go.py.name: OpenCode Go connection
api/src/services/opencode_go.py.description: Holds the address, request style and identifying headers needed to reach the OpenCode Go service.

api/src/services/provider_catalog_servic.name: Provider connection test
api/src/services/provider_catalog_servic.description: Checks that a saved AI service password works and lists the models that connection can offer.

api/src/services/tool_registry.py.name: Workflow tools
api/src/services/tool_registry.py.description: Makes the workflows marked as tools available to agents, and describes each one's inputs so the model can use it.

api/src/services/tool_schema.py.name: Tool input rules
api/src/services/tool_schema.py.description: Describes what a tool expects as input and checks an agent's arguments before that tool is allowed to run.
